notes.title: To all players
notes.content:
I'm sorry, because I'm working on the game I Fantasized Again, I haven't updated Pig Training Legend for a long time.
The main reason is that I lack the funds to complete the updates for Pig Training Legend. So, I started working on I Fantasized Again at the end of March to raise funds. Please rest assured, I won't let Pig Training Legend become an unfinished work; I want it to be a memorable piece for everyone.
But the updates will have to wait until I finish this new project. Around June, I Fantasized Again will be released, and then Pig Training Legend will be updated. Thank you all for your understanding and support all along.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3668800/_/

notes.content: A volume adjustment slider has been added (DLC required).

notes.title: v0.73 has been updated DLC required.
notes.content: v0.73 has been updated. Added 1 transition CG and 2 story CGs. Fixed a bug where the CG recollection room would swap character CGs. Thank you all for your continuous support. In fact, I read every piece of feedback from each update. It is because of your support that I have come this far. I sincerely appreciate it. I will keep working hard.

notes.title: The v0.72 update requires DLC.
notes.content: The v0.72 update requires DLC. It adds a large map system and a new CG. I’ll try to maintain a higher update frequency going forward, sorry for being busy earlier.

notes.title: Merry Christmas! 【And update plans】
notes.content:
【Next month, I will update:

notes.title: Welcome to version v0.65.
notes.content: Welcome to version v0.65. This version resets levels 2-3, as well as the farming, alchemy, and store interfaces. The current DLC is under review.

notes.title: Welcome to version V0.5
notes.content:
Welcome to version V0.5. This version updates the main menu UI, but unfortunately, level 10 has not been updated this time.
[Next update preview: Store background changes, farm UI adjustments, level 10, and reset of levels 2-3]

notes.title: v0.3 version update. 【Added level 9.】
notes.content:
v0.3 version update.

1.Optimized the text box display, now multiple languages will no longer appear together!
2.Optimized the UI of the start screen.
3.Added a tutorial to the main menu.
4.Added level 9.
5.The pigsty can now enable automatic harvesting.】[v0.3バージョンの更新。
If you find that the mod is not working, please update to the new version of the mod!

notes.title: Version V0.2 has been released! You can now play levels 1-8!
notes.content: Welcome to version v0.2! This version adds a CG recollection feature to the pig farm, adjusts the position of the exit button, and allows you to play levels 1-8!! By the way, pressing 【Tab】 in the CG interface can hide the dialogue box! Thank you for your support, I will continue to work hard!

notes.title: Emergency Fix!
notes.content: Fixed the bug where the third pig could not be harvested and the bug where item acquisition in battle scenes was abnormal.

notes.title: The time for the next update
notes.content: By 12.15 or earlier, I will release it as soon as possible.
